description: Read reviewed public payment product scopes for two to four payment-category provider slugs side by side, with their evidence, sources and unknowns. Optional filters label each full scope confirmed, country-unknown or not-matched using the same rules as search. Does not rank providers or establish eligibility.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; excluded countries do not match.

currency.description: Currency or crypto asset code. A ticker does not imply a network.

integrations.description: Any selected integration; all filter categories must match one product scope.

methods.description: Any selected method; all filter categories must match one product scope.

items.description: Exact provider slug returned by search_payment_capabilities; copy it rather than guessing. Use the lowercase hyphenated identifier (1-120 characters), not a title or full URL.

name: compare_payment_capabilities
title: Compare payment capabilities
